articles.title: US-Saudi strikes on Iraq kill at least 20 across Iraq
articles.summary: US-Saudi strikes on Iraq kill at least 20 across Iraq At least 20 Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF) fighters have been killed and 32 wounded in US-Saudi attacks across Iraq, the group said. The PMF said the initial death toll could increase as teams continue assessing the affected sites. The attacks targeted its positions in seven provinces: Baghdad, Wasit, Nineveh, Basra, Kirkuk, Karbala and Diyala. The state-sanctioned umbrella organisation, which largely comprises Shia armed groups, said the strikes also damaged buildings, vehicles and military equipment.

The artillery fire came from an Israeli military position in the Tel al-Nahas area, near the occupied Lebanese border village of Kfar Kila. The NNA described the shelling as “intense and concentrated”. Israel carried out the attack despite its “ceasefire” agreement with the Lebanese government and continuing diplomatic efforts to end the Israeli occupation.
